subject: English
question_text: Write a summary of the passage in no more than 70 to
guide_solution: Summary : English has become a global language because it has worldwide appeal and importance. Learning English doesn't mean degrading our own language. Our neighbouring countries have put much emphasis on English. India, Pakistan and Srilanka have progressed in science and technology because of their command over English. In our country the condition of learning English is not well. So our graduates face a lot of problems to get a good job. So we should learn English.  অনুবাদ(Passage No. 2) : See Barisal Cadet College. Sl. No. 12; Page No. 57
source: SSC English 1st Paper Test Paper 113 — Kazirchar Secondary School, Barisal
